boundary.description: From the point where the M60 Motorway crosses the River Medlock, S by the Motorway, W by Manchester Road, Droylsden Road, Ashton Road, Manchester Road and Sunnybank Road. Across Droylsden High School Playing Fields, to the northern boundary of Sunny Bank Park and by a bee-line running east of the Ashley Road Estate to the point where River Medlock crosses Edge Lane, and E along River Medlock to the M60 Motorway.
